# J84 exact numerical continuation checkpoints — NOT certified polyhedron classes

These three complete literal numeric point arrays are the actual best-feasible checkpoints from the coordinator's new live-mass material continuation. They are preserved as exact decimal JSON inputs, not as exact own(S,U,H) certifications. The S/U fields were floating nominations on a triangular hull; weak status and exact all-positive-bar census have not been certified for these checkpoint bodies. They are not110 and do not replace canonical C622. Their production sources and all non-default parameters are in [internal-source-reference], J84_LIVE_MATERIAL_METHODS_COMPLETE.md, requiring the exact inputs/helpers from [internal-source-reference] and [internal-source-reference].

The first two checkpoints are exactly the nested best objects of the completed barconstrained84_{0,1}.json reports. The third is the actual interrupted repair84_0_best.json object. Compact JSON serialization below preserves every point and value; whitespace differs from the original pretty checkpoint files and the hashes below identify these compact seed files. No optimizer state or unobserved completion is implied.

Manifest, including final LF:
barconstrained84_0_SEED.json3006B/SHAb86e9c51ff456df375df5b5a53252f532ce3a2a16374eca5d9cde61513c9029f
barconstrained84_1_SEED.json3065B/SHA654793640edafc6f7b818e7620ad1ae4b8490f893174c3419aa0fcbad86f56c6
repair84_0_SEED.json3003B/SHA671192b00d78c543ea6e9f65cb07debdc8105d9a3e98c40d3dac297eefc54631

Use the first two directly with repair84_portable.py --run0/1 from the method material. To resume from the interrupted repair checkpoint, deliberately substitute its full point array as the new starting base and record that this creates a new bounded restart (including newly centred coordinate bounds); it does not recover SLSQP's hidden state. The source field min_primal_constraint in repair covers the minimum of BOTH primal witness and Q-sum-budget constraints. Original margin1e-8, allowed save relaxation1e-10, Q-sum cap.28, repair coordinate radius.25, tau1e-5. Repair0 was interrupted by a120000ms container timeout; repair1 was not started. No completed600-iteration marker was observed.

The first two checkpoints achieved numerical total Q objective~.2628133/~.2618389 with U1 but S31/S32, so the improvement fragments the polar basin rather than cancelling it. Repair checkpoint improves the two-root-exempt cosine loss to.00574614 but still has numericalS30/U1. The actual next question is reconsolidation with genuine all-bar/own-mass control, not merely a smaller witness loss. Full positive terms below floating floors remain an exact-audit obligation.
